name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Catalog browsing/search, cart, checkout, profile/address, and order-history calls.

description: Public React SPA storefront: catalog browsing/search, product detail, cart, account registration/profile/addresses, checkout, and order history. Calls ceramics-api for all data and signs customers in via the shared user-auth Thunder dependency. Does not process payment directly; checkout redirects/tokenizes through the payment gateway via ceramics-api.
